instruction: PART 1 – FIND THE DEFINITION. Match the words underlined with their definitions.

items.questionText: mild
in advance
items.correctAnswer: before something happens or is expected to happen

items.questionText: inhibited
items.correctAnswer: to prevent someone from doing something by making them feel nervous or embarrassed

items.questionText: prompt
items.correctAnswer: done quickly, immediately, or at the right time

items.questionText: allowance
items.correctAnswer: money that you are given regularly, especially to pay for a particular thing

items.questionText: endurance
items.correctAnswer: the ability to keep doing something difficult, unpleasant, or painful for a long time

items.questionText: ancestry
items.correctAnswer: the members of your family who lived a long time ago

items.questionText: humiliate
items.correctAnswer: to make smb feel ashamed or stupid, especially when other people are present, embarrass

items.questionText: moderate
items.correctAnswer: not very large or very small, very hot or very cold, very fast or very slow etc

items.questionText: subtle
items.correctAnswer: not loud, bright, noticeable, or obvious in any way

items.questionText: recruiting
items.correctAnswer: to find new people to work in a company, join an organization, do a job etc

items.questionText: fine ... for
items.correctAnswer: to impose a financial penalty on someone as a punishment for violating a rule, law, or regulation.

instruction: PART 4 - WORD FORMATION. The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the sentences. Fill in each space in this way. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: 1. Sugar and salt ______ easily in water. (SOLVE)
2. Since consumers are always demanding new products, companies which can be ______ are more likely to succeed. (INNOVATE)
3. They incorporated the work of anthropologists and ______ into their own research. (HISTORY)
4. Competitiveness is the key to job ______ and the key to competitiveness is the control of inflation. (CREATE)
5. Our priority is to tackle ______ and global inequality. (POOR)
6. One reason commercial diet companies are having problems is that they received a lot of bad ______ in the early nineties. (PUBLIC)
7. Extreme religious groups living in ______ communes have been responsible for a number of violent crimes. (ISOLATION)
8. Adjectives (big, green), verbs (come, go), conjunctions (and, but) and prepositions (to, in, for) are all ______ of words. (CATEGORIZE)
9. By ______ speed limits and passing red lights, we somehow got to the airport in time. (REGARD)

10. The factory's waste was disposed of in a nearby river, creating an ______ situation for the local community since it caused pollution which could harm the environment and the health of the people. (DESIRE)
